summary: QIAGEN N.V. furnished a Form 6-K on November 6, 2026, covering the quarter ended September 30, 2026, whose operative disclosure is a November 4, 2026 press release reporting unaudited third-quarter 2026 results (Exhibit 99.1). The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer earnings report, the US-equivalent of a domestic quarterly earnings release; it recites non-GAAP adjusted measures (gross profit, operating income, pre-tax and net income, tax rate, diluted EPS), free cash flow and constant-currency comparisons, plus reconciliations. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated. Nothing for a risk-arb angle; watch ordinary earnings and guidance sensitivity.
